criteria.text: A file larger than 5 MB is rejected with HTTP 413 and nothing is stored.
Only PNG and JPEG images are accepted; any other type is rejected with HTTP 415.
The stored file name has any directory part removed, so a name like ../../etc/passwd.png is stored as passwd.png.
Uploading identical content again returns HTTP 200 with the existing id and stores no second copy.
Every upload is passed to the virus scanner before it is stored; an infected file gets HTTP 422 and is not stored.
Only the owner can delete a file; anyone else gets HTTP 403 and the file remains.
